question: task_category
instructions: Classify the user's coding-agent prompt into exactly one category based on the primary kind of work it is asking for.

planning.description: Planning, complex reasoning, architecture decisions, brainstorming, tradeoff analysis, open-ended design discussion. No code is being written yet.

coding.description: Writing, editing, refactoring, or debugging code; implementing a spec; fixing a bug; running/fixing tests.

research.description: Research, codebase exploration, reading/summarizing docs or source, answering 'how does X work' or 'where is Y defined' questions.

fallback.note: Used when Jev is unavailable, low-confidence, or returns a category with no configured/available model.
